column1: Where did we go wrong? What turned you against us? Was it money? Power? We can offer those. As far as you've drifted from us, we still know your value as a mercenary. Please, accept this offer and aid us.
column2: 我们哪里做错了吗? 是什么让你背叛了我们? 是钱? 权? 我们都可以给你. 哪怕你已经背离了我们，我们仍然了解你作为一个雇佣兵的价值. 求你了，接受这份要约帮助我们.

column1: Comrade, the Restoration would like to call upon you again. You served adequately in the past, and we entrust you with this contract in the hope that you can show us some of that old fire you once had.
column2: 同志，光复会希望再次征召你. 你过去的服务相当好，我们将这份合约委托于你，希望你能让我们看到一些你曾拥有的那份斗志.

column1: Commander, the Restoration's fortunes rest upon your shoulders. Should you aid us in this task, both of us will be enriched by the outcomes. I hope you have the time to help us, and are willing to do so.
column2: 指挥官，光复会的命运落在了你的肩上. 如果你在这项任务中协助我们，那我们双方就都能从结果中受益. 我希望你能有时间来帮我们，也有意愿来帮我们.

column1: My friend, the time is here once again: House Arano needs help, and you're the best positioned to lend it to us. We appreciate everything you've done for us, and as such we are prepared to reward you generously for your service.
column2: 我的朋友，这一时刻又来了: 阿拉诺家族需要帮助，你是最适合向我们提供帮助的人. 我们欣赏你为我们所做的一切，因此我们准备好好奖赏你的工作.

column1: Excellent work, Commander. I was right to put my faith in you. You're a critical part of the Restoration effort.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。我把信任托付给你是对的。你是复国事业的关键一环。

column1: It wasn't a total wash, but it sure wasn't a roaring success, either. I understand that not every mission is going to be a gold-star victory, but I hope this isn't an indication of future performance.
column2: 这次任务算不上彻底失败，但也绝对不是大获成功。我明白不是每次任务都能拿满星凯旋，但我希望这并不预示着今后的表现。

column1: I'm sorry to learn your mission was a failure, Commander. I hope that occurrences like this will be rare. If they're not, you'll probably be out of 'Mechs before too long.
column2: 得知你的任务失败，我很难过，指挥官。我希望这类事情会很少发生。如果不幸不是，你恐怕很快就会没有机甲可用了。

column1: Desperate times call for desperate measures. We wouldn't be asking to hire you unless we had no other choice. Hopefully you can help us.
column2: 非常时期需要非常措施. 除非我们别无选择，否则我们不会要求雇佣你. 希望你能帮到我们.

column1: Times are changing, Commander. There is a need in the Directorate for one of your skills. Contracts like this one will pave a way for your future, through us. That future need not be dark.
column2: 时代变了，指挥官. 理事会需要一个你那样技艺的人. 这样的合约会为你的未来铺好路，通过我们. 那样的未来不会昏暗.

column1: A rising tide lifts all ships, Commander. House Espinosa is rising quite quickly. Continue to work for us, and we'll ensure you continue to be a prominent figure in the Reach.
column2: 好风凭借力，指挥官. 埃斯皮诺萨家族正飞快地崛起. 继续为我们工作，我们就会保证你成为远邦的头面人物.

column1: I must say, at this rate I'll soon be calling you a friend, Commander. The Directorate's fortunes are rosy, thanks in no small part to you. Let's continue our relationship, shall we?
column2: 我得说，照这样下去，我很快就可以称呼你为朋友了，指挥官. 理事会的前景一片大好，这在很大程度上要归功于你. 让我们继续我们的关系，好吗?

column1: My friend, I hope this missive finds you well. House Espinosa trusts and values MechWarriors such as yourself and those of your company. This contract is one for only our most esteemed allies, and I do hope you will accept it.
column2: 我的朋友，希望收到这封信时你一切顺利身体安康. 埃斯皮诺萨家族信任你和你公司的那些机甲战士，也重视你们. 这份合约只寄给我们最尊敬的盟友，我真心希望你能接受它.

column1: Not all battles are so easy to win. Fear not, commander, this is but one minor setback that can be corrected.
column2: 并非所有战斗都那么容易取胜。别担心，指挥官，这只是一次小小的挫折，可以纠正。

column1: You disappoint me, commander. For the sake of your company, I would hope that this does not become a habit.
column2: 你让我失望了，指挥官。为了你的公司着想，我希望这不会成为习惯。

column1: You wanna get paid, don't you? Take this job, and we all end up with more money. You've nothing to lose.
column2: 你想拿报酬，对吧? 接下这个任务，我们都会赚得更多. 你不会损失任何东西.

column1: That went well. Real well. Seems like we did the right thing in calling you in, mercenary. Glad to see we both came out ahead today.
column2: 进展顺利. 非常顺利. 看来请你出手是正确的决定，雇佣兵. 很高兴看到我们今天都获益匪浅.

column1: You didn't get the job done like we wanted, but you tried. And I like that kind of guts, even if I'm not entirely happy with the result.
column2: 你没能按我们希望的那样完成，但你尽力了。我欣赏这种胆气，即使我对结果并不完全满意。

column1: For someone with your hardware, I expected better things. You let us down, Commander—and I'm gonna be sure to tell everyone I know not to count on you in the future.
column2: 以你手上的硬件条件，我本以为你能做得更好。你让我们失望了，指挥官——我保证会告诉我认识的每一个人，以后别再指望你。

column1: I dislike your kind, mercenary. But it seems that desperate times force compromises on all of us. Bear that in mind should you accept this contract: we offer it to you only because we have no other choice. Tread carefully.
column2: 我不喜欢你这样子，佣兵. 但似乎非常时期迫使我们所有人妥协. 你接下这份合约的时候要记住: 我们给你是因为我们别无选择. 谨慎行事.

column1: Greetings, Commander. This is a standard contract, and we expect you to be able to complete it with competence. Try to look grateful, if you accept it.
column2: 你好，指挥官. 这是一份标准合约，我们期待你胜任它. 如果你接受了这个任务，我们会感激你.

column1: My friend, I've got good news: House Calderon needs your help, and we've got plenty of money to pay for that help. We know you've got the skills to see this job done, and any help would be appreciated by my superiors.
column2: 我的朋友，有个好消息: 卡尔德隆家族需要你的协助，而我们资金充裕足以支付酬劳. 我们深知你具备完成这项任务所需的实力，你的任何帮助都将获得我方高层的高度认可.

column1: Good job, Commander. The Calderon Protectorate thanks you for your service. It's always refreshing to deal with a true professional when one hires mercenaries.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。卡尔德隆保护国感谢你的效力。雇雇佣兵时能碰上一个真正的专业人士，总是令人神清气爽。

column1: Out here in the Periphery, it's always a life-or-death struggle for mercenaries. That's why I appreciate your efforts to complete the mission, even if you couldn't manage it.
column2: 在外围地区，对雇佣兵来说永远是生死攸关的搏杀。所以即便你没能完成任务，我依然感谢你为此付出的努力。

column1: I've hired raw cadets that have performed better than your company, Commander. In the future, you'd best operate at a higher level, or we might not be willing to offer you contracts aside from garrison duty.
column2: 指挥官，我雇来的生瓜蛋子新兵表现都比你的队伍强。以后你最好拿出更高的水准，否则除了驻防任务，我们可能就不愿再给你合约了。

column1: Even ComStar occasionally requires the services of mercenaries, Commander. We will look highly upon you, should you aid us.
column2: 即使是通讯之星偶尔也需要雇佣兵的服务，指挥官. 如果你帮助我们，我们就会高看你.

column1: ComStar congratulates you on your successful mission, mercenary. We are pleased you've been able to assist us so thoroughly.
column2: 康星祝贺你任务成功，佣兵。我们很高兴你能如此彻底地协助我们。

column1: It seems apparent that while you failed to achieve our goals, you engaged the enemy for as long as you were able. Better luck next time, Commander. May the Spirit of Blake be with you.
column2: 这看起来似乎很显然，虽然你没有达成我们的目标，但已经尽你所能来和敌人交战了. 希望你下次能走运一些，指挥官. 希望布雷克的精神与你同在.

column1: Far be it from a simple organization like ComStar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, butâ€¦ your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像通讯之星这样简单的组织本不该在作战事务上斥责你，指挥官，但……你在那次行动中的表现实在糟糕透顶。我们对你的无能予以严正谴责。

column1: We have a job for you, Mercenary scum. As distasteful as that is to us.
column2: 我们这里有一份工作给你，佣兵渣滓. 尽管这让我们感到很不愉快.

column1: Mercenary though you may be, you seem effective enough. House Davion has need of your skills, Commander.
column2: 也许你只是个佣兵，但似乎挺能干. 戴维恩家族需要你的才能，指挥官.

column1: Greetings, Commander. House Davion requires aid from someone outside of our own forces. Hopefully you can help us.
column2: 你好，指挥官. 戴维恩家族需要一些我军以外的人提供帮助. 希望你能帮到我们.

column1: House Davion requires mercenaries of skill, Commander, and you fit the bill nicely. With luck, we will both profit from this arrangement.
column2: 戴维恩家族需要专业的雇佣兵，指挥官，你正好符合我们的要求. 如果运气好，我们双方能从这一安排中达成双赢.

column1: You have served us well in the past, Commander. We value this relationship, and would like to preserve it.
column2: 你在过去为我们提供了良好的服务，指挥官. 我们很重视这段关系，并希望能保持它.

column1: Greetings, Commander. Once again, House Davion requires your services. Should you be successful, we will both profit.
column2: 你好，指挥官. 再一次，戴维恩家族需要你的服务. 只要你能完成这个任务，那我们都能从中获益.

column1: Honored friend! Your acts in service to House Davion have not been forgotten. In light of this, we present you with this choice contract.
column2: 尊敬的朋友! 戴维恩家族不会忘记你为家族所做的一切. 为此，我们向你提出这份优质的合约.

column1: Excellent performance, Commander. The Federated Suns are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
column2: 表现出色，指挥官。联邦太阳国对您的成就与展现出的技艺十分满意。报酬将足额奉上！

column1: Well, let it never be said House Davion does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
column2: 嗯，可别让人说戴维恩家族不信慈善。显然，你的本领无法与我们正规军相提并论——所以我们不怪你没能完成合约。

column1: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
column2: 得了吧，雇佣兵——你到底有没有尽力去履行合约，还是以为我们会为你自己的无能付钱？如此糟糕的表现得不到奖赏，只能受到训斥。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Duchy Of Andurien. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 老实说，我不知道我们为什么还要给你提供合约. 很明显，你并不是安杜瑞恩公国的朋友. 不管怎么说，我们正处于危急关头，所以只能退而求其次.

column1: Greetings, mercenary. Lowly and despicable though you may be, you may yet serve our interests. Finish this job, and we may look upon you with more favor than you likely deserve.
column2: 你好，佣兵. 虽然你们也许卑微又令人厌恶，但你还是能为我们的利益服务. 完成这项工作，我们或许会高看你一些.

column1: The Duchy Of Andurien has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 安杜瑞恩公国需要像你这样的雇佣兵，指挥官. 我想你会对附件中的合约感兴趣. 希望我们能达成互惠互利的协议.

column1: The Duchy Of Andurien would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 安杜瑞恩公国希望向你提供一份优选合约，指挥官. 作为一家受人尊敬的雇佣兵公司的领袖，我想你应该会认为这份合约的条款既公平又合理.

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Duchy Of Andurien would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望这封信送达时你一切安好. 安杜瑞恩公国的人民敬重你的能力，因此希望向你提供一份合约. 请慎重考虑.

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Duchy Of Andurien. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友. 这份合约可不是我们会提供给普通雇佣兵的合约，但你已经证明了自己的忠诚、实力，以及对安杜瑞恩公国理想的坚定信念. 希望你会接受我们的提议.

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Humphreys is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——汉弗莱斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Duchy Of Andurien understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 安杜里恩公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: We are deeply disappointed in your performance, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield were those of a raw cadet, not the leader of a mercenary company.
column2: 我们对你的表现深感失望，指挥官。你在战场上的作为像个新兵，而不是一名佣兵团的领袖。

column1: Despicable as you are, House Kurita can still find a use for your services. Attend, Commander: your betters have need of you.
column2: 尽管你令人厌恶，但栗田家族仍然可以为你的服务找到用处. 注意，指挥官: 你的上级需要你.

column1: You are not of our blood, mercenary, but your skills are robust enough. We would grant you money and renown if you aided us.
column2: 你不是我们一族，佣兵，但你的技巧是够强劲的. 如果你协助我们，我们可以为你提供金钱和声望.

column1: House Kurita respects your martial prowess, mercenary. Aid us, and we will ensure you are well paid for your efforts.
column2: 栗田家族十分敬重你的武力，佣兵. 加入我们，我们保证你能得到丰厚的报酬.

column1: Once again, the Draconis Combine requires your assistance, mercenary. You have served us well in the past, so we would like to entrust you with this mission.
column2: 再一次，天龙联合体需要你的帮助，佣兵. 你过去为我们提供了很好的服务，因此，我们希望将此任务委托给你.

column1: I apologize for disturbing you, my friend, but the Draconis Combine once again needs your help. Undertake this task for us, and I will see that you are richly rewarded.
column2: 我很抱歉打扰你，我的朋友，但天龙联合体再次需要你的帮助. 为我们承担这个任务，我会保证你能收到丰厚的报酬.

column1: The Draconis Combine is pleased with your fervor, Commander. Your skills in battle are precisely the sort that young cadets could learn from.
column2: 天龙联合体对你的热忱表示赞赏，指挥官. 你的作战技艺正是年轻的军校生可以学习的典范.

column1: While your retreat would be grounds for censure in one of our soldiers, we understand that a mercenary life is more… complicated. We hope it will not become a habit, however.
column2: 虽然你的撤退若发生在我们自己的士兵身上会招致谴责，但我们理解雇佣兵的生活更为……复杂。不过我们希望这不会成为习惯。

column1: Your performance was an embarrassment, Commander. The Draconis Combine expects more of their mercenaries. Keep this up, and we may not offer you any contracts at all!
column2: 指挥官，你的表现令人难堪. 天龙联合体对他们的佣兵期待更大. 如果你继续保持这种状态，那我们可能根本不会给你任何合约!

column1: In desperate times, even the mighty must resort to hiring those such as you. This is a kindness we do to you, mercenary: you serve your betters.
column2: 非常时期必须采取非常措施，哪怕雇佣那些像你这样的佣兵. 这是我们对你的善意，佣兵: 为你的上级服务.

column1: We would not offer you this contract unless we had no other choice, mercenary. As it stands, this is simple: we have a task, and you need money. Accept or don't, it's your choice.
column2: 除非我们别无选择，不然我们不会给你这份合约，佣兵. 就目前来说，这很简单: 我们有一个任务，而你需要钱. 接不接受，由你决定.

column1: The Capellan Confederation has need of your unit, mercenary. And you have need of our money, I assume. I think this will benefit both of us.
column2: 卡佩拉联邦需要你的佣兵部队. 而我认为，你需要我们的钱. 我想我们都能从中获益.

column1: There are few mercenaries House Liao trusts with tasks like this, Commander. Make certain our faith is not misplaced. We can both profit from this.
column2: 指挥官，能让廖氏家族信任地托付这种任务的佣兵可不多. 请确保我们的信任没有错误地托付. 我们都能从中获益.

column1: Hello, Commander. The Capellan Confederation would like your assistance with a particular matter. In exchange, we will ensure you are well rewarded.
column2: 你好，指挥官. 卡佩拉联邦希望你能在一件特别的事项上予以协助. 作为交换，我们会保证你能得到丰厚的报酬.

column1: I'm glad you're well, my friend. Once again, House Liao would like to call upon your prowess. Undertake this task for us, and we will pay you the highest possible rates. I assure you, this is not a contract for lesser warriors.
column2: 很高兴你一切安好，我的朋友. 廖氏家族再次希望借助你的能力. 接受这项任务，我们会向你支付尽可能高的酬劳. 我向你保证，这可不是给普通战士的合约.

column1: My old friend, I hope this message finds you well. If you have the time, the Capellan Confederation would once again like to retain your services.
column2: 我的老朋友，我希望收到这个消息的时候你一切顺利身体安康. 如果你有时间，卡佩拉联邦希望能再一次得到你的服务.

column1: House Liao has always believed in one thing, Commander: victory at any cost. It seems you also understand this vital lesson. We are pleased you've performed so well.
column2: 指挥官，廖家始终信奉一件事：不惜一切代价取胜。看来你也深谙这一要义。我们对你的出色表现很满意。

column1: Loss on the battlefield is not always failure. Losses teach us to improve and better ourselves. You fought well, Commander, even if you did not prevail. Learn from this lesson and do better next time.
column2: 在战场上失利并不完全意味着失败. 失利教会我们改善和提升自己. 你打得不错，指挥官，即使你没有取得胜利. 引以为戒，在下次任务中做得更好.

column1: If you cannot accomplish the missions we lay before you, Commander, we will find another mercenary who can! Consider this a warning to perform better—or be replaced.
column2: 指挥官，如果你无法完成我们交给你的任务，我们会另找一位能完成的雇佣兵！把这当作一次警告：要么干得更好，要么被替换。

column1: We've heard you're a competent mercenary. We've been having some trouble lately, and if you could resolve it for us, we'll ensure you're paid well. If not, so be it.
column2: 我们听说你是一名相当能干的雇佣兵. 我们最近遇到了一些麻烦，如果你能帮我们解决的话，我们保证你能得到丰厚的报酬. 如果不能，那就算了.

column1: Well done, Commander. We obviously placed our faith in the right mercenary company. We'll let you know if we have any other work for you.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我们显然把信任交给了正确的佣兵团。如果还有活我们通知你。

column1: You win some, you lose some. Sometimes it's in between. I'm disappointed you couldn't complete the contract, but at least you gave it your best shot.
column2: 有输有赢。有时介于两者之间。我很失望你没能完成合约，但至少你尽力了。

column1: For somebody who came so highly recommended, you let us down pretty hard. Thanks for nothing, I guess.
column2: 对于一个被强烈推荐的人来说，你却让我们很失望. 算我自讨没趣，我猜.

column1: I don't know why we bother with you, Mercenary. Perhaps my superiors are desperate. Regardless, they've seen fit to offer you this contract against my better judgement, Accept it or don't, it doesn't matter to me.
column2: 我不知道为什么我们双方会为你费心，佣兵. 或许我的上级已经绝望了. 无论如何，虽然我有不同看法，但他们觉得给你合约是最合适的，无论你接不接受，对我都没有什么影响.

column1: You may be a disgrace and a scoundrel, but you're one of the only mercenaries in the area. Apparently the Magistracy has seen fit to offer you this contract despite my protests. Don't make us regret this.
column2: 虽然你是个丢人现眼的流氓无赖，可还是这片区域唯一的一家佣兵. 显然自治区不顾我的反对，觉得适合给你这份合约. 可别让我们后悔.

column1: Commander, there's a task I need handled. While your reputation is not as positive as it could be, you're convenient and the price is right. Do this and we'll look favorably on you in the future.
column2: 指挥官，我需要处理一项任务. 虽然你的声望还不是很正面，但你正好方便而且价格也不错. 完成这项任务，未来我们会看好你.

column1: Commander, I hope you are in good health, This contract may interest you - it fits your skills and the strengths of your company. With any luck, we'll both get what we want out of this job.
column2: 指挥官，希望你一切安好. 这份合约你或许感兴趣--它非常适合你的能力和贵公司的实力. 运气好的话，我们双方都能各取所需.

column1: Greetings, Commander. I have a task that you are well suited to perform. Accomplish this, and I'll personally ensure my superiors know about your skills.
column2: 你好，指挥官. 我有一项任务非常适合由你来完成. 若能成功，我会亲自确保我的上级知晓你的才能.

column1: I hope you're well, my friend. We in the Magistracy needs your help once again. This contract may interest you - especially the bottom line. I think you'll find our conservation more than fair.
column2: 希望你安康，我的朋友. 身处自治区的我们再一次需要你的帮助. 这份合约也许能引起你的兴趣--特别是底价. 我想你会发现我们的保护条款非常非常公平.

column1: I wouldn't entrust this contract to any lesser mercenaries, Commander. You and yours are the only ones I believe are capable of handling this task. As always, I'll ensure you are richly rewarded for your hard work.
column2: 指挥官，我不会把这份合约托付给任何不那么厉害的佣兵. 我相信只有你和你的人才有能力应对这项任务. 一如既往，我保证你的努力工作会得到丰厚的回报.

column1: Your performance was exemplary, Commander. I'll be certain to ensure the upper echelons of Magistracy high command hear about your skills.
column2: 你的表现堪称典范，指挥官。我一定会确保治安官辖区最高指挥部的上层听到你的本领。

column1: Despite your failure, I'll ensure that high command understands that you fought as hard as you were able. There's always next time, Commander.
column2: 尽管你失败了，我会确保最高指挥部明白你已经竭尽全力作战。总还有下一次，指挥官。

column1: Understand that we hired you with an expectation of - if not success - at least decent effort. You've shown neither, and I'm going to ensure my superiors hear about it, Commander.
column2: 希望你能明白，我们雇你时，期待的是——就算不能成功——至少也得有像样的努力。你两者都没做到，而我会确保我的上级知道这件事，指挥官。

column1: I don't know why we bother with you, mercenary. Perhaps my superiors are desperate. Regardless, they've seen fit to offer you this contract against my better judgment. Accept it or don't, it doesn't matter to me.
column2: 我不知道为什么我们双方会为你费心，佣兵. 或许我的上级已经绝望了. 无论如何，虽然我有不同看法，但他们觉得给你合约是最合适的. 无论你接不接受，对我都没有什么影响.

column1: Commander, there's a task we need handled. While your reputation is not as positive as it could be, you're convenient and the price is right. Do this, and we'll look favorably on you in the future.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要处理一项任务. 虽然你的声望还不是很正面，但你正好方便而且价格也不错. 完成这项任务，未来我们会看好你.

column1: Greetings, Commander. The Magistracy of Canopus has a task that you are well suited to perform. Accomplish this, and I'll personally ensure my superiors know about your skills.
column2: 你好，指挥官. 船底自治区有一项任务很适合你. 完成它，我会亲自确保我的上级会知晓你的才能.

column1: Your performance was exemplary, Commander. I'll ensure that the Magistracy high command hears about your skills.
column2: 你的表现堪称典范，指挥官。我会确保法域最高指挥部知道你的本事。

column1: Despite your failure, I'll make sure that high command understands you fought as hard as you were able. There's always next time, Commander.
column2: 尽管你失败了，我会确保最高指挥部明白你已尽全力作战。总还有下次，指挥官。

column1: Understand that we hired you with an expectation of, if not success, at least decent effort. You've shown neither, and I'm going to ensure my superiors hear about it, Commander.
column2: 你要明白，我们雇用你时，即便不指望你成功，至少也期待你能拿出像样的努力。可这两样你都没做到，我会确保我的上级知道这件事，指挥官。

column1: I don't know why we bother offering you contracts, to be perfectly honest. It's obvious you're not a friend to the Free Worlds League. Regardless, we find ourselves in desperate times, so we have to scrape the bottom of the barrel.
column2: 老实说，我不清楚为什么我们会费心向你提供合约. 显然你并不是自由世界联盟的朋友. 无论如何，我们正处于非常时期，所以我们只能使出最后一招.

column1: The Free Worlds League has a use for mercenaries like you, Commander. I think you'll be interested in the attached contract. Hopefully we can come to a mutually beneficial agreement.
column2: 自由世界联盟会用到像你这样的佣兵，指挥官. 我想你会对附上的合约感兴趣的. 希望我们双方能达成互利的协议.

column1: The Free Worlds League would like to offer you a choice contract, Commander. As the leader of a respected mercenary company, you should find the terms both fair and equitable, I think.
column2: 自由世界联盟乐意给你提供一份优质合约，指挥官. 作为可敬的佣兵公司的领导人，我想你应该会发现这条款既公平又公正.

column1: Commander, I hope this message finds you well. The people of the Free Worlds League would like to extend a contract to you, owing to our respect for your skills. Please consider it carefully.
column2: 指挥官，希望你一切安好. 自由世界联盟的人民愿意向你提供一份合约，以表达我们对你能力的尊重. 请好好考虑一下.

column1: Greetings, my friend. This contract is not one we would offer to a lesser mercenary, but you've proven your loyalty, prowess, and dedication to the ideals of the Free Worlds League. I hope you'll accept our offer.
column2: 你好，我的朋友. 这份合约不是我们会提供给普通雇佣兵的，但你已经证明了你的忠诚、能力，以及对自由世界联盟理想的奉献. 我希望你会接受我们的邀请.

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Marik is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 顶级表现，指挥官——马里克家族对你的成绩非常满意。继续保持，我会确保更多活找上你。

column1: The Free Worlds League understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 自由世界联盟明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了可贵的努力，即便最终失败。这不过是下一场战斗的又一课。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——马里克-斯图尔特联邦对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Marik-Stewart Commonwealth understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 马里克-斯图尔特联邦明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: We don't usually contract mercenaries directly, Commander, but this is a special case. The rates and hazards are commensurate with your experience and MechWarriors. We hope to hear from you soon.
column2: 我们通常不直接联系佣兵，指挥官，但这个是特殊情况. 这个任务的风险和报酬都与你的经验和机甲战士相称. 我们希望能尽快得到你的答复.

column1: Far be it for a simple organization like Comstar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, but… Your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
column2: 像康星这样简单的组织本不该在战争事务上责备你，指挥官，但是……你在那次行动中的表现简直糟糕透顶。我们严厉谴责你的无能。

column1: We've got a need for a mercenary to help us out with a little problem. I hope you're up for the task, Commander.
column2: 我们需要一个佣兵来帮忙解决一些小问题. 我希望你已经准备好接受这个任务，指挥官.

column1: The Oriente Protectorate understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 奥连特保护国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—House Cameron-Jones is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——卡梅伦-琼斯家族对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Regulan Fiefs understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 雷古兰封地明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Commonality is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——共同体对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Rim Commonality understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 边缘共同体明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: You know the rule of war, don't you? 'Money can buy anything except honor.' While you have none of the latter, we have plenty of the former. Fight like the dog of war you are, and we may overlook your past transgressions.
column2: 你知道战争的规则，不是吗?“金钱可以买到任何东西，除了荣誉.”虽然你没有后者，但前者我们有很多. 像战争猛犬一样战斗，我们可以忽略你过去的罪过.

column1: Beggars can't be choosers, and neither can the frugal. This contract is a budget affair best suited to scoundrels such as yourself. No matter what your failings, you are willing to fight for money, yes? We can provide money.
column2: 叫花子没得选，节俭的人也没得选. 这份合约的预算很适合你这样的无赖. 不管你有什么缺点，你都愿意为钱而战，对不? 我们能提供钱.

column1: Hail, Commander. House Steiner has an operation we think you'll find interesting as well as lucrative. I'll be certain to recommend you to my superiors if you perform well.
column2: 你好指挥官. 施泰纳家族这里有一项任务，我们认为你会感兴趣而且有利可图. 如果你表现好的话，我一定会把你推荐给我的上级.

column1: I hope you are in fine health, Commander. The Lyran Commonwealth has been pleased with your prior service, and we think this contract might be best suited for an expert like you. As always, we offer the highest rates.
column2: 希望你身体安康，指挥官. 天琴共同体非常满意你之前的服务，我们认为这份合约也许非常适合你这样的专家. 一如既往，我们会提供最高的报酬.

column1: Large coffers pay for larger victories—and you have been instrumental in ensuring that our winning streak is intact. Excellent work, mercenary. House Steiner is pleased.
column2: 更大的金库换来更大的胜利——而你在确保我们连胜不败上起到了关键作用。干得漂亮，雇佣兵。施泰纳家族很满意。

column1: The Lyran Commonwealth didn't get where it is by accepting victory or defeat as inevitable, but by continuing to fight after a loss. I hope you'll do the same, Commander. While you were defeated, you acquitted yourself well.
column2: 莱兰联邦不是靠把胜利或失败视为必然才有今天的地位，而是靠在失败之后继续战斗。我希望你也能如此，指挥官。你虽然战败，但表现可圈可点。

column1: House Steiner has no place for cowards or failures, Commander. Ensure your future efforts are more robust, or the Lyran Commonwealth will be no friend to you.
column2: 指挥官，施泰纳家族没有胆小鬼或失败者的位置. 确保你未来的成绩更加强劲，不然天琴共同体不会同你交好.

column1: Top-tier work, Commander—The Duchy is very happy with your performance. Keep it up, and I'll make sure a lot more work comes your way.
column2: 一流的活儿，指挥官——公国对你的表现非常满意。继续保持，我保证会有更多工作找上你。

column1: The Duchy of Tamarind-Abbey understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a fine effort, even if it failed. Just another lesson for the next battle.
column2: 塔马林德-阿比公国明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你已经付出了出色的努力，即便它失败了。这不过是下一场战斗的又一条教训。

column1: This contract may be of interest to you, Commander. The Taurian Concordat believes it within your ability to complete, and in times like these, we are willing to pay you well to see it done. Please let us know.
column2: 这份合约也许能引起你的兴趣，指挥官. 金牛协约国相信它是你力所能及的，值此非常时期，我们愿意支付丰厚报酬以确保任务完成. 敬候回复.

column1: Hello, mercenary. The Taurian Concordat values our relationship, and so we would like to offer you first right of refusal on this contract. The job is simple, and the pay adequate. We know it to be within your capabilities as well.
column2: 你好，佣兵. 金牛协约国看重我们之间的关系，所以我们赋予你这份合约的优先权. 这活很简单，同时报酬也合适. 我们也知道这个任务在你的能力范围之内.

column1: Good job, Commander. The Taurian Concordat thanks you for your service. It's always refreshing to deal with a true professional when one hires mercenaries.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。金牛座协约感谢你的效力。雇雇佣兵时能碰上真正的专业人士，总是让人耳目一新。

column1: Mercenary, we got a Job for you and Money to waste. Do this and you will be compensated above your station.
column2: 雇佣兵，我们有一份工作要交给你，也有花不完的钱. 完成这项任务，你将获得远超你身份应得的报酬.

column1: Welcome Mercenary, we got another Job that requires attention, take it and dont dare to fail us now.
column2: 欢迎你，雇佣兵. 我们又有一项需要处理的工作，接下它，千万别让我们失望.

column1: Still hungry for Money i see. We got something that needs be shot up.
column2: 看来你还想赚钱. 我们有点东西需要被轰掉.

column1: We got a nice Raid planned and need something gone, do this, and we share in the Riches.
column2: 我们计划了一次不错的劫掠，需要清除掉一些东西. 干完这票，咱们共享财富.

column1: Ahh You're back for more? We always got someone to kill and places to plunder, will you join us?
column2: 啊哈，你又回来找活儿干了? 我们总有杀不完的人和抢不完的地方，你会加入我们吗?

column1: Welcome Friend, join us on this Raid and share in the Booty.
column2: 欢迎你，朋友. 加入我们这次劫掠，分享战利品吧.

column1: Well done Mercenary, you are almost worth the money we spent on you.
column2: 干得不错，雇佣兵，你差不多值回我们花在你身上的钱了.

column1: At least you got the Job done. Learn from this before we have to kill you ourself.
column2: 至少你把活儿干完了. 在我们不得不亲手宰了你之前，从这件事里学点教训.

column1: You DARED to fail us? Begone, before i kill you myself!.
column2: 你竟敢让我们失望? 滚开，趁我还没亲手杀了你!
